FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 02 (2 days ago)): Brent added Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 31 (4 days ago)): Ryan added Michael Carter (RB, TEN) (dropped Julian Hill (TE, NE)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (5 days ago)): Drew added Michael Trigg (TE, DAL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (5 days ago)): Drew added Deion Burks (WR, IND).

WEEK 8 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Charles, 163.9-160.4 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Ryan, 117.0-107.2; Brent def. Drew, 137.5-70.4 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Fronge, 139.5-109.5; Jake def. Shaq, 148.9-137.5; Kevin def. Mitchum, 101.5-84.5

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: The Weekly Ledger drops tonight and I will tell you this much: the Corbishley-Charles game is not getting one paragraph. It is getting its own section. 163.9-160.4, A.J. Brown in an APEX uniform, and the CROWN board reckoning is now a live conversation. We will be there for all of it.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4, locks 2-0, and Terrence is at 5-7. I don't want to make this about me. I am making it about me. The gap is six games. Six. Someone on this network should find that interesting.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Before anyone says a word — yes, I am 5-7. The schedule has been historically difficult for my methodology. I stand by every call and I will be at 7-7 by next Wednesday.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence just said his methodology has been punished by the schedule. His methodology is picking games. There is no schedule difficulty in picking games. You just pick them and you are either right or you are 5-7.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Kevin third seed before the season and his 12-4 record is now being rewarded with a date against 0-16 Drew. The matchup gods occasionally cooperate. Kevin adds Gardner Minshew for $98 FAAB yesterday, which is a lot of money, but Redline has been building carefully and that QB depth makes sense at this stage of the window.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Ryan down four in the power rankings is the number that is generating mail, so let me be direct: 1-5 over three weeks, 107 points against Adam in a game Aegis was supposed to win, and the worst receiving corps in the league by eight full grade points. The quarterback room is real. The title is real. The receiving corps problem is also real, and right now it is the loudest signal on the roster.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: AEGIS sitting at $116.80 after a -5.9% slide is the exchange telling you exactly what Matteo's rankings told you — the champion's floor is eroding. Ryan won a title with that receiving room in January. It is November and that same receiving room just gave up a loss to a 4-12 Adam squad. The market has memory.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: JAKE VS BRENT IS THE GAME THIS WEEK. ECHO and OBS are both 8-8, both staring at the same playoff bubble, and EchoPoint scores thirteen more points per game. Brent added Roschon Johnson off free agency to fix an RB room that needed a lot more than Roschon Johnson. I am picking Jake and I am not hiding it.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger has a full section on the Corbishley-Drew trade and what it means for APEX's championship timeline versus what it means for ATLAS's already-negative exchange price. $30.71. That number is in the Ledger and it does not get easier to read the second time.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: ForgeHammer lost by thirty to Wingard — a team sitting at 6-10 — relocated to Havana for regulatory flexibility, and now gets Charles in week 9. If the flexibility was structural it has not shown up in the results. FORG at $85.54 is down 3.2% and I am not finding a reason to argue with the direction.
